'''sumtcita''' = ''modal'' = ''preposition'' = ''adverb'' = ''tag''

<noinclude>
'''sumtcita''' is a Lojban-internal name for particles ([[cmavo]]) of series ([[selma'o]]) BAI, [[PU|PU]], [[ZAhO|ZAhO]], etc. Anything that can tag a noun ([[sumti]]).

The full list is:
# [[fi'o]] + [[selbri]]
# [[BAI]]
# [[CAhA]]
# [[KI]]
# [[CUhE]] (i.e. [[cu'e]] and [[nau]])
# [[ZI]]
# [[ZEhA]]
# [[PU]]
# [[VA]]
# [[FAhA]] and [[MOhI]] + [[FAhA]]
# [[VEhA]]
# [[VIhA]]
# [[PA]] + [[ROI]]
# [[TAhE]] (plus [[fe'e]])
# [[ZAhO]] (plus [[fe'e]])
Plus combinations of them.

{{See_also|tanru versus lujvo rant}}
</noinclude>
